name: Laravel 12 / Vue 3 / Inertia / Flutter
description: Classic web stack: Laravel 12 backend with Inertia 2 + Vue 3 pages (four-screen journey, session-cookie auth, fixed bounded algorithm workbench, /api/v1 JSON envelope with X-Request-Id correlation, failed-login throttle with 429 + Retry-After) implemented and tested (PHPUnit feature suite + real-HTTP smoke script); Flutter mobile client written against the frozen envelope contract but NOT compiled or tested (no Flutter SDK).
